top_comments.text: When I started a carnivore lifestyle three years ago, I tried to focus on developing a big repertoire of menu options, influenced by all the carnivore influencers. Dirty keto carnivore bars and shakes. Carnivore fake breads. Carnivore ice creams and brownies. It was a terrible approach for me and tasted like crap. First, I hate to cook and spending extra time fussing in the kitchen was time AWAY from hiking with my dogs, reading, getting sunlight on my face. Now I enjoy the same foods EVERY DAY and have experienced my carnivore epiphany: One pound of 80/20 ground beef and six over easy eggs, 2 servings of fatty fish ( canned sardines, oysters or sockeye salmon in olive oil), 1/2 cup of full fat pasteurized goat milk kefir, black coffee, water and salt. This is split up into two meals over the course of the day. ONCE weekly I enjoy 4 oz of homemade carnivore chicken liver pate just to get that boost of fabulous organ meat nutrition. My grocery list is ridiculously simple and this has worked wonders for my energy and reaching fitness goals. I am sixty two, down to twenty one percent body fat, lifting really heavy weights, hiking with a twenty pound pack, and taking absolutely no medications!
